targets.note: A template: its blanks are chips, Field in the strip lists the fields of the record type.
Read against a record: values in the chips, amber for the fields the record has none for.
An agent's and a person's suggestions: the pane beside the page, Accept all, the card on the one the caret is in.
A draft arriving into the open page: the new sections appear below, the person's place stays.
